The '''New Federation''' is one of the nations of [[Solaris-3]]. The country has been described by some as a technology cult which runs deep in the blood of every citizen, and the course of one's life can change rapidly when research talent has been identified. It is known to possess planes and aerospace companies such as Triumph Avionics, [[Giovanniello|cutting-edge photography equipment]], and hosts an annual exposition for demonstrating global scientific advancement.

[[Lucilla]], now President of [[Startorch Academy]], was the former chief editor for the country's top academic journal. The [[Francesco Montelli|patriarch]] of the Montelli family learnt to modify [[Terminal|Terminals]] while there, the source of the family's highly lucrative Reserved Terminal business. [[Luuk Herssen]] was once head of the Novialle Regenerative Group, a pharmaceutical corporation in the country, whose groundbreaking Ichor is dogged by controversy. Its Sentinel<ref>While its identity remains unknown, this Sentinel may be [[Promeus]]</ref> is a subject of scientific inquiry, although [[Galilei]] says that this research is used by the capital to exploit the Sentinel. While their universities' degrees function like many in the real world, ending with a thesis defense, as [[Anyad]] discovered it is not compatible with Startorch Academy's Synchronist studies.

The New Federations's thirst for knowledge is not restricted to technology, as it is also highly interested in matters of culture. Recent research has focused on the [[Essays on the Ragunnesi Drama|origins of drama culture in Rinascita]], and it has many avant-garde artists whose works are of great interest in Rinascita, such as [[Cordelia|''The Last Jar of Air Before the Lament'']]. Aside from air, the country is also in possession of pre-Lament lunar soil, a sample of which has been donated to Startorch Academy. Karl, the author of the highly popular book [[Second Coming of Solaris]], is from there. It also produces TV shows popular at the Academy.

There are class divisions in the New Federation, ranging from the aristocracy which [[Mortefi]] belonged to, to the [[Exiles]] at the lowest rung of the social hierarchy. Exiles have been blocked from finding legitimate work, facing endless discrimination and prejudice. They resorted to building camps in the country's outskirts, and the place where they gathered became the [[Lawless Zone]]. Once inhabited by gangs, the central government waged war against them until the [[Ghost Hounds]] mercenary group annexed the last gang, and the zone now serves as a source of mercenaries for the schemes of the upper class.

The country has a thriving financial scene, with its corporations having acquired a number of Rinascitan companies in after-hours trading who were forced to reach out to [[KU-Money|the Black Shores]] for assistance. This enhanced financial position means that Fractsidus Vice-Architect [["Eris"]] has established a critical base of operations in the country, securing an unending flow of wealth for the organisation by infiltrating the upper class, corporations, and even government with Fractsidus agents to ensure the continued operation of the terrorist group. [[Verina/Backstory#Character Stories|Verina]] has complained of inflated flower prices and elaborate competitions. Like [[Ashinohara]], resonators are discriminated against, with [[Sue White]]'s parents telling her to never return after being accepted at Startorch Academy.

The country is the birthplace of [[Rabelle's Curve|Dr Scott Rabelle]], although he would leave and eventually settled in [[Lilyland]]. It is known to have a [[Ahab's Diary#Diary 3|Tacetite-eating Wyrm]]. [[Poppe|Deserts exist]] outside the New Federation's cities, although unlike Lahai-Roi's they do not contain swimming fish in the sands. The head of the Spacetrek Collective is a former employee of a New Federation company, Ashridge Energy.

According to one of the movies Lucilla asks you to recommend for her in the Startorch Academy Anecdotes, the New Federation capital is ruled by a corrupt conglomerate of companies.

It is likely related to the [[Maxim (Lahai-Roi)|Old Federation]].

==Trivia==
*The New Federation is inspired by the cyberpunk genre, particularly foundational works such as [[wp:Blade Runner|Blade Runner]] and [[wp:Neuromancer|Neuromancer]]. Combined with other elements such as Lynae's [[Lynae/Backstory#Cherished Items|Cactus Pillow]] suggests that the country may be influenced by these cyberpunk depictions of America, and particularly California.
**[[Maxim (Lahai-Roi)|Maxim]] in the Starward Riseway quotes {{w|Konstantin Tsiolkovsky}}<ref>''"Earth is the cradle of humanity, but one cannot live in a cradle forever."''</ref> when referring to an Old Federation saying, suggesting additional connections to Russia and the Soviet Union.
